<p class="eyebrow">Environmental data science · Ecology · Hydrology</p>
<h1>Following water.<br>Finding connections.</h1>
<p class="intro-lead">I'm Jake Diamond, an environmental data scientist curious about how ecosystems work—and what we can learn by looking a little closer.</p>
<p>I study the connections between water, landscapes, and living things. I also help people make sense of environmental data through analysis, synthesis, and interpretation.</p>
